4 ارسب It caused [a thing] to sink: hence, in a trad., describing the people of Hell, إِذَا طَفَتْ بِهِمُ النَّارُ أَرْسَبَتْهُمُ الأَغْلَالُ When the fire shall raise them, and make them. to appear [or rather to
swim upon its surface], the collars, by reason of their weight, shall make them to sink to the bottom thereof. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And ارسبوا Their eyes sank in their heads by reason of hunger. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
